name: Pipeliners - SEO AEO Audit 2026-06-23
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-06-23

# Summary
SEO and AEO audit of pipelinersusa.com by the local-seo-auditor agent (Jun 23, 2026, read-only). Method: live fetch of the homepage, robots.txt, the sitemaps and several service, city and blog pages, plus status checks across the flat vs /service-areas/ URL sets.

# Key findings
- Index status (GSC data Jun 12): 72 indexed, 275 not indexed; about 164 of those were actionable, mostly "Crawled, currently not indexed".
- P0-1: the MetaSync/OTTO sitemap listed the legacy flat /{city}/ URLs, which at that moment 301-redirected to /service-areas/{city}/; the sitemap had zero /service-areas/ URLs, so the city money pages had no valid sitemap signal.
- P0-2: OTTO "Course" schema still live on /hydro-jetting/ and /pipelining-myths-debunked/ (open Search Atlas ticket).
- P0-3: about 10 OTTO-injected homepage links pointed at redirecting flat city URLs.
- Homepage had no LocalBusiness or Plumber schema live (a regression from an April audit); OTTO also emitted a duplicate BreadcrumbList.

# Decisions and status
- Fixes were handed to the Search Atlas owner and Kim (sitemap base URL or a switch to the Rank Math sitemap; Course to Service or Article in OTTO).
- Context changed quickly: the Jun 18 task verification found the city pages had moved back to flat /{city}/ URLs with /service-areas/ redirecting to them, and the sitemap issue resolved.
